name: ignite
text: A bundle of dry reeds and a torch catching fire with a soft whoosh, then flames crackling, one short burst of fire, sound effect only, no music, no speech

name: flag
text: A wooden flagpole driven firmly into hard ground with one heavy thud, then a large cloth banner snapping open in the wind, sound effect only, no music

name: oar-1
text: One long wooden oar stroke on a river: the oar creaking in its oarlock, the blade dipping into water and pulling through with a soft swish, a single stroke, sound effect only, no music

name: oar-2
text: A single heavy rowing stroke of a war boat, wooden oar knocking in the oarlock then the blade sliding through river water, dripping at the end, sound effect only, no music

name: hullcreak
text: An old wooden ship hull creaking and groaning under strain, one slow deep timber groan, sound effect only, no music

name: splash
text: A heavy object falling into a river with a big splash followed by small waves lapping, one splash, sound effect only, no music

name: stakecrash
text: A wooden boat hull smashing onto sharp wooden stakes under the water, loud timber cracking and splintering, one violent impact, sound effect only, no music

name: chain
text: Heavy iron chains pulled taut between two ships: a sharp metallic clank, rattling links, then a strained creak, sound effect only, no music

name: grapple
text: A rope with an iron grappling hook whipping through the air and biting into wood with one hard thunk, sound effect only, no music

name: warcry
text: A crowd of a hundred soldiers shouting a fierce battle cry together outdoors, powerful and slightly distant, a single roaring shout, sound effect only, no music

name: crow
text: Two crows cawing in the distance over a battlefield, sound effect only, no music

name: buffalo
text: A water buffalo lowing once, one deep moo in the countryside, sound effect only, no music

name: stingloss
text: A short somber defeat sting: one low heavy drum hit and a descending mournful horn, about three seconds, cinematic, ancient Asian war

name: bowheavy
text: A very powerful war bow release with a deep twang followed by a fast arrow whoosh, one shot, sound effect only, no music

name: wave
text: A rising tidal surge of water rushing forward with a deep rolling roar and foam, sound effect only, no music

name: river
text: A wide river flowing steadily with small waves lapping against wooden boats, calm seamless looping ambience, no music, no voices, no birds
